claims.claim: One round has the exact form T(p)=reverse(p_i : i in D) followed by (p_i : i not in D), where D={i>=2 : p_i<p_{i-1}} and both subsequences otherwise retain index order.
claims.evidence: If D={d_1<...<d_k}, the scan marks exactly p_{d_1},...,p_{d_k}. Successive MoveToFront operations leave these elements at the front as p_{d_k},...,p_{d_1}. Removing them never changes the relative order of the unmarked elements, proving the formula. Direct list-operation simulation agreed with the formula on every permutation of sizes 1 through 9.
claims.witness: For marked indices d_1<...<d_k, the front block after the j-th move is p_{d_j},...,p_{d_1}; after all moves it is reverse(p_i:i in D).
claims.search_method: Symbolic derivation from the source pseudocode, followed by exhaustive direct simulation over 409113 permutations.

claims.claim: There is an exact reduction of every maximum-element phase to parallel deletion in a word. Once i+1,...,n are fixed, write the active prefix as L i R. Define A(r_1...r_s)=(r_j : 2<=j<=s and r_{j-1}<r_j). The number of further rounds until i is fixed is h(R)=min{t:A^t(R) is empty}.
claims.evidence: All active values are below i, so i is never marked. If R is nonempty, r_1 is marked because r_1<i; for j>=2, r_j is unmarked exactly when r_{j-1}<r_j. Claim 0 therefore puts every marked element before i and leaves precisely A(R) after i. The fixed larger suffix is untouched. Induction gives A^t(R) as the word to the right of i after t rounds, and i is fixed exactly when that word is empty. Every possible active-prefix permutation through size 9 was checked independently.
claims.witness: For R=(2,4,1,3), the successive right words are (2,4,1,3), (4,3), and empty, so the phase lasts exactly two rounds.
claims.search_method: Boundary-case and quantifier analysis of the round map, plus exhaustive phase-state comparison for every active prefix of sizes 1 through 9.

claims.claim: If W(n) is the worst-case number of nontrivial rounds, then W(n)<=n(n-1)/2. Consequently no permutation family requires omega(n^2) rounds.
claims.evidence: When i is the largest unfixed value, i+1,...,n form a permanently fixed suffix. Its phase has duration h(R). For any nonempty word w, A discards its first entry, so |A(w)|<=|w|-1 and h(w)<=|w|. Here |R|<=i-1. Once i is fixed it remains fixed, so the nontrivial rounds partition into decreasing maximum phases, giving W(n)<=sum_{i=2}^n(i-1)=n(n-1)/2. Hence every family has round count divided by n^2 at most 1/2, ruling out little-omega(n^2).
claims.witness: The phase-length bounds are n-1,n-2,...,1, whose exact sum is n(n-1)/2.
claims.search_method: Universal phase decomposition with explicit empty-phase and persistence checks; finite exhaustive results were also compared with the bound.

claims.claim: For p_n=(n,1,2,...,n-1) and n>=3, at least n-1+floor((sqrt(8(n-1)+1)-1)/2) rounds are required.
claims.evidence: With B_0 empty and B_{m+1}=(m+1)T(B_m), induction using Claim 0 gives T^t(p_n)=B_t,n,t+1,...,n-1 for 0<=t<=n-1; thus n first becomes fixed after exactly n-1 rounds, at state B_{n-1},n. For m>=2, write B_m=mR. Since A(B_m)=A(R) and both words are nonempty initially, h(B_m)=h(R). The decreasing-stack deletion invariant assigns an entry one plus the largest label among smaller popped entries. Induction on m=q(q+1)/2+r, with 0<=r<=q, gives maximum label q for B_m; equivalently h(B_m)=q=floor((sqrt(8m+1)-1)/2). Therefore fixing the next active maximum takes q additional rounds. The recurrence, stack height, and bound were checked exactly for n=3 through 250.
claims.witness: At t=n-1 the state is B_{n-1},n; the value n-1 remains unfixed for exactly q additional rounds, where q(q+1)/2<=n-1<(q+1)(q+2)/2.
claims.search_method: Symbolic induction on the special-family recurrence and the monotone-stack deletion invariant, corroborated by exact-integer stress testing.

The direct marking implementation and closed round map were cross-checked on every enumerated permutation, supplying both lower witnesses and exhaustive upper bounds.
